entries.title: II Thessalonians 3:1
segments:
V. 1. May run-Go on swiftly, without any interruption. 
 
  And be glorified-Acknowledged as divine, and bring forth much fruit.

entries.title: II Thessalonians 3:2
segments: V. 2. All men have not faith-And all men who have not are more or less unreasonable and wicked men.

entries.title: II Thessalonians 3:3
segments:
V. 3. Who will stablish you-That cleave to him by faith. 
 
  And guard you from the evil one-And all his instruments.

entries.title: II Thessalonians 3:4
segments: V. 4. We trust in the Lord concerning you-Thus only should we trust in any man.

entries.title: II Thessalonians 3:5
segments:
V. 5. Now the Lord-The Spirit, whose proper work this is. 
 
  Direct-Lead you straight forward. 
 
  Into the patience of Christ-Of which he set you a pattern.

entries.title: II Thessalonians 3:6
segments:
V. 6. That walketh disorderly-Particularly by not working. 
 
  Not according to the tradition he received of us-The admonition we gave, both by word of mouth, and in our former epistle.

entries.title: II Thessalonians 3:10
segments: V. 10. Neither let him eat-Do not maintain him in idleness.

entries.title: II Thessalonians 3:11
segments: V. 11. Doing nothing, but being busybodies-To which idleness naturally disposes.

entries.title: II Thessalonians 3:12
segments: V. 12. Work quietly-Letting the concerns of other people alone.

entries.title: II Thessalonians 3:14
segments: V. 14. Have no company with him-No intimacy, no familiarity, no needless correspondence.

entries.title: II Thessalonians 3:15
segments: V. 15. Admonish him as a brother-Tell him lovingly of the reason why you shun him.

entries.title: II Thessalonians 3:16
segments:
V. 16. The Lord of peace-Christ. 
 
  Give you peace by all means-In every way and manner.
